preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N, K, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of arrays A and B, N, is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= K <= 10**9 for N, K, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of allowed operations K is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= abs(Ai) <= 10**5 for Ai in A) for N, K, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element in array A has an absolute value between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= abs(Bi) <= 10**5 for Bi in B) for N, K, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element in array B has an absolute value between 0 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and len(B) == N for N, K, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of arrays A and B are equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= 10**15 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and 10^15 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max_interaction(N, K, A, B) for (N, K, A, B), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum possible interaction value after performing at most K operations on array A.
